description: (needs account token) Restores the previous version of a site. Restore undoes the last Update or Edit files save. Doing it again restores the version that was replaced. confirm=true applies it. Refused for a suspended or inactive site. Does not charge. After the site is claimed, the human can Restore from the site's Update screen.

confirm.description: True applies the change. False leaves it unchanged and the reply describes what would change.

site.description: The address of the site, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.
